## Primary record

- DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02737-9
- PMID: 40640531
- Article: *Benchmarking single-cell multi-modal data integrations*
- Benchmark code: https://github.com/bm2-lab/SCMMI_Benchmark
- Pipeline: https://github.com/bm2-lab/SCMMIB_pipeline
- Catalog entry: `SCMMIB_2025`
- Local entry: `python/11_scmmib_manifest.py`

## What problem does it address?

SCMMIB evaluates multimodal integration across paired, unpaired and mosaic tasks using accuracy, robustness and scalability measurements. It is an evaluation resource, not a new universal integrator.

## Minimal input contract

1. A dataset/task manifest specifying modality pairing and the task type.
2. The exact preprocessing and train/test split used by the benchmark pipeline.
3. Runtime, memory and GPU records for scalability comparisons.

## Interpretation boundary

A method ranking is conditional on task, modality, dataset and metric. Use the benchmark to choose candidates, then validate the selected method on the user's own platform and biological replicates.

## Reproduction status

The personal catalog currently records the task and dataset manifest only. The official benchmark pipeline must be run in its pinned environment before quoting metric values.
